segmentation: one item per independently executable action; a trigger is metadata; wait is an item only when separately scheduled and tracked with its own completion or cancellation

route.rejection: zero exposed items and zero action attempts for every incomplete, invalid, over-cap, no-action or cancelled batch

corpus_provenance: 1960 complete utterances are literal source lines in tracked general-*, unique-*, dedicated-*, development.txt and pc2-authored.tsv files; synthetic transcript sessions are identified as synthetic, partitioned by session and speaker; assemble_corpus.py only packages them
prior_annotation_round: T-3096/T-3097 labels for v2 are void; v3 was held before annotation; neither is v4 gold
model_visible_input: only the raw utterance string from model-input.jsonl; the JSONL wrapper, source identifiers, condition, pair arm and game_action_trace are evaluator or annotator data and never enter the candidate prompt
raw_only_identifiability_gate: Every PC-2 arm and at-cap/cap-plus-one boundary row must state whether a separate wait/watch order is explicitly opened or explicitly refused; a requested wait must have its own completion condition. raw_identifiability.py classifies utterance text before comparing it with private trace-derived expectations.
limit_note: Provisional admission values for S0. S1 measures and finalizes them before a green claim; each injected lower test limit uses the production guard. RSS is reported separately.
